title: The Good Friday Agreement commits the parties to democratic and peaceful means
summary: The 1998 Good Friday Agreement commits the parties to exclusively democratic and peaceful means.
body: The Good Friday Agreement reaffirms a total commitment to exclusively democratic and peaceful means of resolving political differences, and opposition to any use of force. It also sets consent as the basis of relationships within Northern Ireland and between north and south. The agreement is a negotiated text after decades of violence. It is not a claim that violence then ended. The wording on the page includes: "South, and between these islands. 4. We reaffirm our total and absolute commitment to exclusively democratic and peaceful means of resolving differences on political issues, and our opposition to any use or threat of force by others for any political purpose, whether in regard to this agreement or otherwise. 5.
